title: Managing Anger as a Parent
learningOutcomes: Understand the key ideas behind managing anger as a parent and why this topic matters for child development.
Learn practical skills and strategies that help apply managing anger as a parent in everyday parenting situations.
Build confidence using managing anger as a parent to support connection, safety, and positive family routines.

modules.title: Understanding the Topic
modules.description: Learn what managing anger as a parent means and why it matters for child development.

modules.title: Core Skills and Strategies
modules.description: Explore practical skills and strategies for applying managing anger as a parent in everyday parenting.

modules.title: Real-Life Application
modules.description: See how managing anger as a parent works in real situations with examples and simple scripts.

modules.title: Reflection and Integration
modules.description: Reflect on your learning and plan how to use managing anger as a parent in daily family life.

caseworkerSummary: This topic helps parents build practical skills related to managing anger as a parent. It supports safer, more consistent caregiving by improving understanding, strengthening emotional connection, and reducing stress in daily routines. This topic is suitable for parents who need guidance in applying positive parenting strategies and may benefit families working toward stability, reunification, or improved home safety.
